external_parameter_policy.failure_policy: No competitor is tuned against benchmark outcomes. Every scientific parameter equals the locked ANDREA ToolSpec default; only caller seeds and non-parameter input/execution contracts may differ. A method whose defaults cannot run on the declared panel is blocked rather than retuned.
